faq.q: How is transit changing in this part of Chilliwack?
faq.a: BC Transit's service changes effective January 4, 2026 moved Route 57 Broadway's Carleton Street service one block east to McNaught Road with new stops on McNaught and Acorn, added Sunday-evening service on Routes 51, 53 Fairfield and 57 Broadway, and expanded weekend trips on Route 66 Fraser Valley Express, which serves Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby daily.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Chilliwack Proper East is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
